messages:
kai: FYI we opened a limited canary for Dedicated mi450 in us-west-2 and sa-sao. This is an edge-capacity option between a100x and mi500 for latency-sensitive medium models. Docs + opt-in: https://internal.redwood.ai/dedicated/mi450-canary :sparkles:

deploy-bot: canaries deployed -> us-west-2a, sa-sao-1. Run id: rbw-can-2150000123. Basic health checks passed.

marta: Quick policy q  are these covered under existing reserved SKUs or new pricing?

kai: New SKU `dedicated.mi450.hour` for GA. Preview/canary customers billed under `DED-MI450-CANARY`. Existing reserved commitments require change order to migrate.

sre-bot: SRE watchlist: p95 latency, GPU mem pressure, and KV eviction spikes. Suggested alerts: `histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(request_duration_bucket[5m])) > 500`, `gpu_memory_used_ratio > 0.8`, `increase(kv_evictions[5m]) > 0`.

billing-bot: Note: preview discounts apply for first billing period. Finance will post code mapping.

ops: Runtime note: mi450 uses current kernel set but enabling `--enable-mi450-optim` improves tail latency. No image changes required.

sam: Any limitations to call out?

kai: Known limits: no autoscaling for canary pools, preemptibles disabled, multipart model sharding untested. Recommend single-node configs for models up to 30B. Perf matrix next Tue.

marta: I'll prep customer outreach for opt-in and top customers.

kai: CLI opt-in example:
```
redwood reserve create --pool mi450 --region us-west-2 --gpus 2 --commit 1mo --contact team@example.com --canary
```

kai: Follow-ups: perf readout + dashboards by EOD tomorrow, office hours Thu 15:00 UTC for SRE & Sales.
